title: November 28, 2018 Austin City Council Discussion
transcript:
AUSTIN CITY COUNCIL 
 
COUNCIL DISCUSSION 
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 28, 2018 
3:00 PM 
AUSTIN CONVENTION CENTER,  
BALLROOM C,  
500 E CESAR CHAVEZ ST,  
AUSTIN, TX 78701 
 
Cap Metro Project Connect Work Session 
 
3:00 PM 
Attend a Capital Metro Board of Directors meeting that will focus on community 
and stakeholder engagement for Project Connect.  
 
 
 
 
A quorum of Council members may be present. No action will be taken. 
 
The City of Austin is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. 
Reasonable modifications and equal access to communications will be provided upon request. 
For assistance, please call 512-974-2210 or TTY users route through 711.
